notes: DISABLED 2026-07-16 (issue #3797 audit): the previous seedUrls (/careers, /career, /jobs, /karriere, /offene-stellen, /lavora-con-noi) were unverified default guesses — none is the real path. The real official careers page is https://www.bancastato.ch/carriere (301-redirect target of the page indexed by search engines, /su-di-noi/chi-siamo/informazioni-utili/posti-vacanti-e-carriera.html). Verified live 2026-07-16 via direct curl (realistic browser UA) AND an independent Jina Reader render (r.jina.ai, handles client-side content) of /carriere and its only 3 sub-pages — /carriere/candidatura-spontanea, /carriere/crescita-formazione-e-opportunita, /carriere/percorsi-di-formazione (confirmed the full and only set via sitemap.xml): none contains a job-listing structure. BancaStato runs a spontaneous-application-only model ('candidatura spontanea') and has never published individual open positions on its own site. scripts/detect-ats.mjs finds no ATS signature (unknown, 0 confidence). No jobup.ch or jobs.ch company page exists for 'bancastato' (404 after locale-prefix redirect). Confirmed open reqs (e.g. 'Responsabile Registro Centrale') surface only on LinkedIn, which has no reliable crawl path in this codebase (see dot-life.json for the same LinkedIn-guest-API dead end, tested live the same day). No viable structured source to build a dedicated crawler against.
